name: Length
description: Longest dimension of a part along its main axis.

name: Thickness
description: Material thickness of a wall, arm, or sheet.

name: Gap
description: Open distance between two features at rest.

name: Outer diameter
description: Outside diameter of a round part such as a pipe.

name: Hole inset
description: Distance from a board edge to a hole centre.

name: Depth
description: How far a socket, slot, or clip reaches.

name: Height
description: Vertical extent of a part or feature.

name: Clearance
description: Extra space added to a mating dimension so printed parts fit. Default 0.3 mm for FDM printing.

name: Offset
description: Position of a feature along an edge, measured from one end.

name: Build volume
description: Printer build volume as width x depth x height in millimetres, when the user supplies one.
